exhibits.title: Welcome to VIT Vellore
exhibits.subtitle: A Place to Learn, A Chance to Grow
exhibits.shortDescription: Official welcome to the Vellore Institute of Technology Virtual Heritage and Innovation Museum.
exhibits.description: Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT) was founded in 1984 as a self-financing institution called Vellore Engineering College. Over four decades, it has evolved into a world-renowned Institution of Eminence (IoE) and Deemed University, hosting over 40,000 students across sprawling campuses with students and faculty from more than 50 nations.
exhibits.imageAlt: Official Emblem of Vellore Institute of Technology
facts: Founded by Dr. G. Viswanathan in 1984 with an initial cohort of 180 students
Conferred Deemed University status by Union Ministry of HRD in 2001
Recognized as an Institution of Eminence (IoE) by the Government of India in 2019
Consistently ranked among the top 15 universities in India by NIRF

exhibits.title: Founding of Vellore Engineering College
exhibits.subtitle: Pioneering Self-Financing Technical Education
exhibits.shortDescription: Established in 1984 by Dr. G. Viswanathan with 180 students in three engineering branches.
exhibits.description: In 1984, Vellore Engineering College (VEC) was established under the North Arcot Educational and Charitable Trust. Founded with the mission of providing affordable, world-class technical education to students across Tamil Nadu and India, the college commenced operations with just 180 students across Mechanical, Electrical, and Civil Engineering disciplines.
exhibits.imageAlt: Dr. G. Viswanathan, Founder and Chancellor of VIT
facts: Started with 180 students and 3 undergraduate engineering disciplines
Pioneered self-financing engineering collegiate models in southern India
Affiliated initially with the University of Madras before autonomous status

exhibits.title: Dr. G. Viswanathan — Founder & Chancellor
exhibits.subtitle: Visionary Leader, Parliamentarian & Educational Statesman
exhibits.shortDescription: Dr. G. Viswanathan founded VIT with a lifelong commitment to national development through higher education.
exhibits.description: Dr. G. Viswanathan was born in 1938 near Vellore. A distinguished lawyer, former Member of Parliament (Lok Sabha), and former Minister in the Government of Tamil Nadu, he founded Vellore Engineering College in 1984. He was awarded an honorary doctorate by West Virginia University, USA, and numerous national and international lifetime honors for transforming Indian private higher education into a globally competitive benchmark.
facts: Former Member of Parliament and Tamil Nadu State Cabinet Minister
Conferred Honorary Doctorate by West Virginia University, USA
Recipient of FeTNA Lifetime Achievement Award for Educational Leadership
Architect of the university motto: 'A Place to Learn, A Chance to Grow'

exhibits.title: Conferment of Deemed University Status
exhibits.subtitle: Ascent to National University Standing
exhibits.shortDescription: In 2001, the Union Ministry of HRD conferred Deemed University status, adopting the name VIT.
exhibits.description: In recognition of rapid academic growth, high research output, and state-of-the-art campus infrastructure, the Ministry of Human Resource Development (MHRD), Government of India, conferred Deemed-to-be-University status upon VEC in 2001 under Section 3 of the UGC Act. This milestone granted complete academic autonomy to modernize curricula and introduce pioneering credit systems.
exhibits.imageAlt: Official Deemed University Seal of VIT
facts: Autonomous curriculum development and industry-aligned syllabi
Pioneered credit-based modular learning systems across engineering schools
Rapid expansion of postgraduate and doctoral research programs
exhibits.sourceTitle: Ministry of HRD Gazette & VIT University Status

exhibits.title: Technology Tower (TT) Landmark
exhibits.subtitle: Architectural Icon of Computational Excellence
exhibits.shortDescription: Constructed during the 2000s campus modernization, TT houses advanced computer science laboratories.
exhibits.description: The Technology Tower (TT) is one of the most recognizable architectural landmarks of the Vellore campus. Standing as a multi-story modernist complex, it accommodates advanced supercomputing centers, software development laboratories, smart lecture halls, and faculty departments for computing and data sciences.
facts: Houses SCOPE and SITE computer laboratories with high-speed networks
Features distinctive architectural modernist silhouette visible across the campus
Integrated with smart digital podiums and energy-efficient environmental systems

exhibits.title: Pioneering ABET USA Accreditations
exhibits.subtitle: First Indian University to Secure ABET Recognition
exhibits.shortDescription: First in India to receive international ABET accreditations for engineering degree programs.
exhibits.description: VIT achieved a landmark milestone by securing ABET (Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology, USA) accreditation for its core undergraduate engineering programs, starting in 2010. This validated that VIT engineering degrees meet rigorous American and global educational quality standards, opening international mobility for graduates.
facts: First university in India with engineering programs accredited by ABET (USA)
Continuous outcome-based education benchmarks aligned with the Washington Accord
Seamless credit recognition for higher studies in top US and European universities

exhibits.title: Institution of Eminence (IoE) Recognition
exhibits.subtitle: Conferred by the Government of India
exhibits.shortDescription: Designated as an Institution of Eminence (IoE) in 2019, joining an elite group of Indian universities.
exhibits.description: In 2019, the Ministry of Education, Government of India, designated VIT as an 'Institution of Eminence' (IoE). This prestigious status provides greater administrative and academic freedom to hire international faculty, admit foreign students, and build world-class research facilities aimed at breaking into top 100 global rankings.
facts: One of only a select few private institutions selected across India
Empowered with greater autonomy to pursue frontier scientific research
Catalyzed substantial investments in cutting-edge laboratory infrastructure
exhibits.sourceTitle: Government of India - Institution of Eminence Notification

exhibits.title: VIT Vellore 372-Acre Sprawling Campus
exhibits.subtitle: Miniature 3D Interactive Masterplan
exhibits.shortDescription: A miniature architectural representation of iconic buildings across the 372-acre eco-friendly campus.
exhibits.description: The Vellore campus spans 372 acres of landscaped grounds along the Katpadi railway junction. The masterplan includes major academic complexes (Technology Tower, Silver Jubilee Tower, Main Building, Dr. MGR Block), Periyar E.V.R. Central Library, Anna Auditorium, modern residential towers, indoor sports stadiums, and solar energy installations.
facts: Sprawling 372-acre self-contained eco-friendly smart campus
Over 1.5 million square meters of built-up academic and residential spaces
Green campus initiatives including rainwater harvesting, solar microgrids, and extensive tree cover
24/7 internal shuttle services and pedestrian avenues

exhibits.title: Central VIT Heritage & Main Gateway Monument
exhibits.subtitle: Honoring Four Decades of Excellence (1984–2024)
exhibits.shortDescription: Architectural rectangular monolith featuring the official VIT insignia, motto, and iconic main gate arch.
exhibits.description: Standing at the heart of the ground-floor atrium, this central monument commemorates VIT's four-decade transformation. The front face features the official embossed emblem and university motto 'A Place to Learn, A Chance to Grow', while the reverse showcases the iconic main entrance arch on Ranipet-Vellore Road that welcomes scholars from 50+ countries.
exhibits.imageAlt: Iconic VIT Vellore Main Entrance Gateway
facts: Front face: Official University Insignia & 3D gold relief lettering
Back face: Iconic Vellore main entrance archway photograph
Flanked by eight illuminated mini-spotlights and deep royal navy podium trim

exhibits.title: Academic Schools & Multidisciplinary Faculties
exhibits.subtitle: Pioneering STEM, Business, Sciences & Law
exhibits.shortDescription: Comprehensive academic structure comprising specialized engineering, computing, sciences, and design schools.
exhibits.description: VIT Vellore organizes academic programs across dedicated schools: SCOPE (Computer Science & Engineering), SITE (Information Technology), SELECT (Electrical Engineering), SENSE (Electronics Engineering), SMEC (Mechanical Engineering), SCE (Civil Engineering), SCHEME (Chemical Engineering), SAS (Advanced Sciences), SBST (Bio Sciences & Technology), VITBS (Business School), VITSOL (Law), and V-SPARC (Architecture).
facts: 15+ multidisciplinary schools offering 60+ undergraduate and postgraduate programs
Interdisciplinary research curriculum combining computing, AI, and domain engineering
Over 2,000 highly qualified faculty members with doctorates from premier institutions

exhibits.title: Fully Flexible Credit System (FFCS)
exhibits.subtitle: Empowering Students to Craft Their Own Learning Path
exhibits.shortDescription: Pioneered in Indian higher education, FFCS allows students to choose courses, faculty, and timings.
exhibits.description: VIT was a pioneer in India in introducing the Fully Flexible Credit System (FFCS). FFCS empowers students to customize their academic schedules by choosing their courses, faculty professors, semester credit loads, and lecture slots. Students can pursue minors in emerging fields such as Artificial Intelligence, FinTech, Cyber Security, or Sustainable Design alongside major degrees.
exhibits.imageAlt: Students in Smart Classrooms under FFCS
facts: Complete freedom to choose subjects, faculty members, and study schedules
Enables major-minor degree combinations across interdisciplinary fields
Promotes self-paced learning, fast-tracking credits, and industrial internship semesters

exhibits.title: Periyar E.V.R. Central Library
exhibits.subtitle: A 6-Storey Repository of Global Knowledge
exhibits.shortDescription: Six-story air-conditioned central library housing over 300,000 volumes and digital knowledge portals.
exhibits.description: The Periyar E.V.R. Central Library at VIT Vellore is a sprawling six-floor learning complex. It houses more than 300,000 print books, thousands of international journals, full access to IEEE, ACM, Springer, Elsevier Scopus databases, automated RFID checkouts, dedicated video lecture rooms, and 24-hour reading halls.
facts: Six floors with a seating capacity for over 1,500 students simultaneously
Over 300,000 print volumes and access to 50,000+ digital scientific journals
RFID-enabled automated borrowing kiosks and high-speed research computer stations

exhibits.title: Main Administrative Building & Central Quad
exhibits.subtitle: The Governance & Historic Heart of the University
exhibits.shortDescription: The white neoclassical administrative building fronted by sprawling manicured lawns.
exhibits.description: The Main Administrative Building represents the institutional governance hub of VIT. It houses the offices of the Chancellor, Vice-Chancellors, Registrar, Admissions Center, and International Relations Office. Fronted by palm-lined avenues and manicured gardens, it stands as an enduring emblem of the university's academic heritage.
exhibits.imageAlt: Main Administrative Building at VIT Vellore
facts: Administrative governance center for admissions, examinations, and leadership
Houses the Office of International Relations facilitating 300+ global partner programs
Fronted by iconic central lawns and ceremonial parade grounds

exhibits.title: Grand Staircase & Accessible Elevator Transition
exhibits.subtitle: Connecting Floor 1 (The Journey) to Floor 2 (Innovation & Impact)
exhibits.shortDescription: Walk up the grand staircase or use the accessible elevator to enter Floor 2 exhibits.
exhibits.description: The grand architectural staircase provides a seamless transition from the ground floor historical galleries to the upper floor research, achievements, and student life exhibitions. Equipped with smooth walking slopes and an accessible direct elevator call button, visitors can effortlessly navigate between both levels.
facts: Smooth slope ramp collision ensures effortless WASD keyboard walking
One-click accessible elevator teleport allows instant floor switching
Signage: 'FLOOR 2 — INNOVATION, IMPACT & CAMPUS LIFE'

exhibits.title: Research & Innovation Ecosystem
exhibits.subtitle: 50,000+ Scopus-Indexed Publications & High-Impact Citations
exhibits.shortDescription: VIT ranks among the top research-intensive universities in India with sponsored projects and patents.
exhibits.description: VIT fosters an aggressive research culture backed by multi-crore grants from government agencies such as DST, DBT, DRDO, ISRO, and CSIR. With over 50,000 Scopus-indexed research publications, high h-index citations, and hundreds of published and granted patents, the university drives real-world scientific solutions in clean energy, health informatics, and autonomous engineering.
facts: Ranked 14th in India under the Research category by NIRF 2025
Over 50,000 Scopus-indexed research papers with high citation impact
Sponsored research funding from DST, BIRAC, MeitY, ISRO, and European Union Horizon programs
Dedicated Central Advanced Research Facility (VCART) with high-end analytical equipment
exhibits.sourceTitle: Research at VIT - Official Metrics & Centres

exhibits.title: Specialized Advanced Research Centres
exhibits.subtitle: Nanotechnology, Clean Energy, Biomedical & Automotive Innovation
exhibits.shortDescription: Interdisciplinary research centres solving frontier global challenges.
exhibits.description: VIT hosts specialized research centres of excellence: Centre for Nanotechnology Research (CNR), Centre for Biomaterials, Cellular & Molecular Theranostics (CBCMT), Automotive Research Centre (ARC), Centre for Disaster Mitigation and Management (CDMM), and CO2 & Green Technologies Centre. These facilities bring together faculty, international scholars, and industry partners to invent next-generation technologies.
facts: Automotive Research Centre testing electric vehicles and autonomous sensor suites
CBCMT developing cancer theranostics, 3D bioprinting, and regenerative biomaterials
Centre for Nanotechnology focusing on solar cells, green hydrogen, and nanosensors

exhibits.title: Interactive Digital Research Table
exhibits.subtitle: Browse Cutting-Edge Patents, Publications & Discoveries
exhibits.shortDescription: An interactive museum tabletop allowing visitors to explore thematic research clusters.
exhibits.description: The digital research table invites visitors to interactively explore four key institutional research pillars: 1) Artificial Intelligence & Robotics, 2) Clean Energy & Electric Mobility, 3) Healthcare & Biomedical Nanotechnology, and 4) Smart City & Disaster Mitigation Systems. Each cluster highlights recent faculty patents, student projects, and societal impact.
facts: Features interactive digital browsing across 4 major strategic research themes
Highlights real patented innovations developed in university research labs
Demonstrates technology transfer to industry and spin-off startup ventures

exhibits.title: VITTBI — Technology Business Incubator
exhibits.subtitle: Over 150+ Technology Startups Incubated
exhibits.shortDescription: Founded in 2003 with support from DST, VITTBI nurtures high-growth tech enterprises.
exhibits.description: Established in 2003 with funding from the Department of Science & Technology (DST), Government of India, the VIT Technology Business Incubator (VITTBI) has nurtured over 150 technology ventures. Providing seed funding, intellectual property guidance, modern office suites, and faculty mentorship, VITTBI is recognized as one of India's premier university-based incubation hubs.
facts: Supported by DST, BIRAC, MeitY, and MSME, Government of India
Over 150 student and faculty startups incubated, generating thousands of jobs
Seed funds disbursed up to multi-crores across deep-tech, med-tech, and AI sectors

exhibits.title: Wall of Achievements & National Recognitions
exhibits.subtitle: Top NIRF Rankings, NAAC A++ Grade & Global Honors
exhibits.shortDescription: Showcasing institutional accolades, top ranking positions, and national championships.
exhibits.description: The Wall of Achievements celebrates VIT's top-tier standing in India and worldwide. The university is accredited by NAAC with the highest A++ grade (3.66/4 score in the 4th cycle). In NIRF 2025 rankings, VIT is placed 14th in the University category, 16th in Engineering, and 14th in Research. Internationally, VIT is consistently featured in the top brackets of QS World University Rankings and Times Higher Education (THE) rankings.
facts: NAAC A++ Grade Accreditation (3.66 CGPA out of 4) in the 4th cycle
NIRF 2025: Ranked 14th in University category, 16th in Engineering, 14th in Research
Ranked in top 800 worldwide by QS World University Rankings and THE World Rankings
Consecutive winners in national Smart India Hackathon and Formula Student competitions

exhibits.title: VIT Around the World — Global Partnerships
exhibits.subtitle: 300+ International University Collaborations Across 6 Continents
exhibits.shortDescription: An interactive world map featuring Semester Abroad Programs (SAP) and international dual-degrees.
exhibits.description: VIT maintains strategic academic agreements with more than 300 prestigious universities worldwide across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Australia, Canada, and Japan. Through the Semester Abroad Program (SAP), students spend a semester carrying out capstone projects in international laboratories, while International Transfer Programs (ITP 2+2) allow dual degrees.
facts: Partnership agreements with 300+ universities across 50+ countries worldwide
Semester Abroad Program (SAP) providing international laboratory project exposure
2+2 and 3+2 dual-degree pathways with premier US and Australian universities
Active member of Erasmus+ and international consortiums

exhibits.title: Life at VIT — Vibrant Campus Culture
exhibits.subtitle: A Cosmopolitan Community of 40,000+ Scholars
exhibits.shortDescription: Curated photo wall illustrating student life, cultural fests, sports, and holistic development.
exhibits.description: With over 40,000 students from all 28 Indian states and union territories, plus international students from over 50 nations, VIT Vellore is a micro-cosmopolis. Campus life buzzes with sports marathons, cultural evenings, literary debates, dance and music festivals, outdoor amphitheater concerts, and late-night food streets.
facts: Students representing all Indian states and over 50 foreign countries
Comprehensive sports facilities including Olympic-size pools, indoor stadiums, and athletic tracks
Round-the-clock student welfare, medical health center, and counseling support

exhibits.title: Riviera — International Sports & Cultural Carnival
exhibits.subtitle: India's First ISO 9001:2015 Certified University Cultural Festival
exhibits.shortDescription: Annual multi-day extravaganza attracting 30,000+ participants from across 600 colleges.
exhibits.description: Riviera is VIT's flagship annual international sports and cultural carnival. Holding the distinction of being India's first ISO 9001:2015 certified college cultural festival, Riviera features 100+ events spanning dramatic arts, music, dance, debates, river marathons, and high-energy celebrity musical pro-shows in the outdoor stadium.
facts: First ISO 9001:2015 certified university cultural and sports festival in India
Over 30,000 student participants representing 600+ universities nationally and internationally
Features the Riviera Marathon advocating social causes and health awareness

exhibits.title: graVITas — Annual Techno-Management Festival
exhibits.subtitle: Where Engineering Ingenuity Meets High-Tech Hackathons
exhibits.shortDescription: Premier technological festival featuring robotics arenas, codathons, and aerospace workshops.
exhibits.description: graVITas is VIT Vellore's annual techno-management festival. Over three intense days, the campus transforms into a technological showcase with competitive robotics combat, 36-hour hackathons, autonomous vehicle design sprints, model rocket launches, and guest lectures from eminent international scientists and industry tech titans.
facts: Over 100+ technical events, robotics tournaments, and multi-track hackathons
Industry collaboration with Fortune 500 tech sponsors providing direct internships
Flagship coding marathons drawing thousands of top programmers across the country

exhibits.title: 120+ Student Clubs, Professional Chapters & Formula Racing
exhibits.subtitle: IEEE, ACM, SAE Formula Student, Robotics & Arts
exhibits.shortDescription: Extensive extracurricular ecosystem fostering leadership, motorsport engineering, and social impact.
exhibits.description: VIT boasts over 120 active student clubs and international technical chapters including IEEE, ACM, CSI, ASME, and SAE. The university's student-built Formula Student racing teams (such as Team Praega, Ojas, and Veloce Racing) design, manufacture, and race formula-style combustion and electric race cars in national and international circuits.
exhibits.imageAlt: Student Teams in Robotics and Automotive Racing
facts: Student motorsport teams build and compete with electric formula race cars globally
Active student chapters in robotics, coding, astronomy, biosciences, and debater clubs
Social service chapters including Red Cross, NSS, and Leo Club conducting rural health outreach
exhibits.sourceTitle: Clubs & Chapters - Student Welfare at VIT

exhibits.title: Student Residential Towers & Campus Facilities
exhibits.subtitle: Modern Living Spaces for 25,000+ Resident Scholars
exhibits.shortDescription: High-rise modern hostel blocks with biometric access, international food courts, and solar power.
exhibits.description: The Vellore campus provides extensive on-campus residential facilities accommodating over 25,000 students. Modern high-rise towers (including S-Block and T-Block) offer air-conditioned rooms, biometric access, multi-cuisine dining catering to Indian and international culinary tastes, gymnasiums, and round-the-clock medical care.
exhibits.imageAlt: Modern Residential Hostel Blocks at VIT Vellore
facts: Accommodates over 25,000 residential students with 24/7 security and Wi-Fi
Multi-cuisine dining options including North Indian, South Indian, and international menus
On-campus healthcare center with 24/7 ambulances and emergency medical specialists

exhibits.title: Convocation, Distinguished Alumni & Global Impact
exhibits.subtitle: Over 200,000 Graduates Shaping Global Industry & Society
exhibits.shortDescription: Graduates leading technological innovation in Fortune 500 corporations, research institutes, and startups.
exhibits.description: Every year, thousands of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral scholars graduate in ceremonial convocations addressed by national heads of state, Nobel laureates, and industry leaders. VIT's global alumni community exceeds 200,000 professionals, holding executive positions at Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Intel, Tesla, civil services, and top academic faculties worldwide.
facts: Over 200,000 alumni across 100+ countries driving scientific and business innovation
Annual placements with record numbers of super-dream offers from Fortune 500 tech firms
Active alumni chapters in Silicon Valley, London, Singapore, Sydney, and Dubai

exhibits.title: VIT Today & The Future — The Journey Continues
exhibits.subtitle: Pioneering Sustainable Technology & Global Leadership
exhibits.shortDescription: Grand museum tour finale reflecting on 40 years of excellence and charting the vision for 2030.
exhibits.description: As VIT Vellore marks over four decades of academic distinction, the university continues to push the boundaries of higher education. With investments in quantum computing, clean hydrogen, climate resilience, and artificial intelligence, VIT remains firmly anchored to its founding vision: empowering youth to build a progressive, knowledge-driven society.
exhibits.imageAlt: VIT 2030 Vision and Sustainable Future Installation
facts: Committed to carbon-neutral green campus operations by 2030
Expanding global interdisciplinary research in clean tech and generative computing
Thank you for exploring the VIT Vellore Virtual Museum!
